newsitem.title: UK: Ldn dry cargo freight market sees higher enquiry.
newsitem.headline: Ldn dry cargo freight market sees higher enquiry.

text.p: Brokers reported panamax owners becoming more confident about immediate market prospects.
Higher levels of enquiry were seen in the grain and fertilizer trades and even some charterers conceded that there might be a slight boost to the freight market in the short term.
Better sentiment was especially evident in the east. The BFI recorded its first gain since 24th march, up 2 to 1260.

GRAIN - More or less static rates were reported in the US Gulf/Japan trades - Halla and Cho Yang were said to have each covered 54,000 tonnes heavy grain for 15/26 and 21/30 May at $21.00 and $21.25 no combo respectively.
Hhalla were said to have fixed a panamax on timecharter to cover grain from US Gulf to South Korea for May on private terms. Cargill booked a small caper on subjects from US Gulf to Egyptian Med.

In the South Atlantic Progress fixed the 1981-built Al Hadjar 65,000 dwt delivery Tubarao for 3-5 months redelivery Atlantic at $8,200 daily plus $145,000 bonus. Andre also booked a 1981-built vessel Sun P 49,000/5 heavy grain Paranagua/Lisbon for 16/21 May at $13.75.

Halla indicated to a 1981-built 64,911 dwt panamax delivery Plate end May/early June trip Far East at $10,500 plus $210,000 bonus. Iranian charterers fixed 50,000/5 corn Up River and Buenos Aires, Bahia Blanca, Necochea or Zone Alpha/Bandar Abbas for 15/30 June at $24.50 option Bandar Khomeini $25.00.

New chartering enquiry included Dreyfus for upto caper size for heavy grain from santos to US Gulf for June 15/30, and Andre with 50,000 heavy grain River Amazon/Lisbon-Hamburg range for mid May. In the handy sizes Toepfer's private fixtures were believed to include Talana 27,000 dwt for grain from US Gulf to Azores and Denmark at about $20.00 and Maroudio about 30,000 tonnes bulk citrus pellets Tampa/Holland at $16.00.
MINERALS - Firmer panamax rates in the Atlantic were confidently forecast by some brokers but reported activity was severely restricted by world holidays.

Halla were believed to be indicating $9,200 daily plus $120,000 bonus to the 1989-built imperial 68,676 dwt for Nopac/Far East, and Pan Ocean were linked with Thalassini Tyhi 73,000 dwt delivery prompt Indonesia for 4-6 months at $9,900 daily.
